name: Hotel Principe di Savoia Milano
insider_take: This palatial 1927 gem stands as Milan's crown jewel, where Neoclassical grandeur meets modern luxury in the heart of the fashion capital.
whats_special: The hotel's stunning rooftop pool offers panoramic views of the Milan skyline, while its historic ballroom has hosted royalty and celebrities for nearly a century. The property features original Art Deco details alongside contemporary Italian design, and houses one of Milan's most acclaimed fine dining restaurants.
pro_tip: Book the Presidential Suite for exclusive access to the private terrace overlooking Porta Garibaldi, and time your visit during Fashion Week when the hotel becomes an unofficial headquarters for top designers.
dont_miss: The world-class Club 10 Fitness & Beauty Centre spa experience, and the hotel's prime location just steps from Corso Buenos Aires - one of Europe's longest shopping streets with over 350 boutiques. The nearby Porta Garibaldi district offers cutting-edge architecture and vibrant nightlife.
